notes: Delete also deletes on Google (1.11.12): deleting a box in the app now deletes its Google Calendar event too — for EVERY mapped box, not only app-created ones (user request, 24 Nov 22:06). The `if eid in created_ids:` gate in the push deletion loop is removed; GoogleNotFound still counts as removed, a delete failure still records an error and KEEPS the mapping so the next push retries, and boxes with no event mapping still make no API call. Deletes already queue the debounced auto-push (~15s) via note_app_edits, so the Google delete happens automatically without the manual push button. Tombstones unchanged (a deleted box is never resurrected by a pull). NOTE: boxes already deleted in the app with a live Google event still on Google will be deleted from Google on the first push after installing 1.11.12 — intended.
